content.text: {"notes":["The requested joint angles and angular velocities are joint-local readouts at absolute time 1.0 s, in rad and rad/s; angles use the stated unwrapped right-hand convention.","The requested tip position is a world-frame vector in meters; the world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up.","Both joints receive a constant applied torque of 0.1476047711728255 N·m, and joint_1 has a scheduled additional +0.5 N·m pulse on [0.5521, 0.6521) s.","joint_limit_by_T is a dimensionless boolean defined as whether either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad, with contact onset rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
